summary: Convert a WHATWG URL to Node HTTP options while preserving URL fields and own enumerable properties.

target.notes: Runtime handling is required when own enumerable properties/getters or subclasses are observable.

semantics.output: ordinary JS object containing protocol, hostname, hash, search, pathname, path, href, port and auth as applicable
semantics.own_enumerables: also copies own enumerable properties of the URL argument in modern Node

caveats: A fixed C# DTO loses enumerable-property copying, getters, and JS object identity/shape semantics.
